caseNameFull: Charlotte Anita Whitney v. The People of the State of California
attorneys: Mr. Walter II. Poliak, with whom Messrs. Walter Nelles and John Francis Neylan were on the brief, for plaintiff in error., Mr. John H. Riordan, with whom Mr. U. S. Webb was on the brief, for defendant in error..

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of section 237 of the Judicial Code as amended by the act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, sec. 2, 39 Stat. 726. See post, p. 538.
